entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl. Government Advocate for the State.

3. The petitioner in this writ petition seeks for a direction to opposite party No.1,- Principal Secretary to Government, Works Department, Odisha, Bhubaneswar to sanction and release the awarded amount in favour of the petitioner for acquisition of land for construction of link road to NH 26 as per the judgment dated 28.09.2022 passed by the learned Presiding Officer, LAR & R Authority, Berhampur in LAR & R Case No.81 of 2021, within a stipulated time.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner has filed an application under Section-64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013) for higher compensation, which was referred to LAR & R Authority, Berhampur for adjudication.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Court below registered it as LAR & R Case No.81 of 2021 and same was disposed of on 28.09.2022 and higher compensation was awarded.
He further submitted that till date the amount has not been disbursed.

5. In view of the above, we dispose of the writ petition with a direction to opposite party No.1 to sanction the amount at an early stage and thereafter the opposite party No.4- Land Acquisition Officer, Kalahandi shall take expeditious step for disbursement of the compensation amount in favour of the petitioner by the end of May, 2024, if there is no other impediment.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
